DECLARE @JobId INT


SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = 'OutreachExport')

EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'Start', 0, 0
EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'Get Outreach Members', 0, 0

DECLARE @ProgNum Varchar(1000)

SET @ProgNum =@varProgNum

Delete from DBO.EPSDT_OUTREACH Where Member_Type='Preservice' and ProgNum=@ProgNum;


INSERT INTO DBO.EPSDT_OUTREACH
SELECT DISTINCT               CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), @ProgNum) AS ProgNum 
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.Market) AS Market
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.Member) AS 'Subscriber No'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.MedicaidNo) AS 'Medicaid No'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.FirstName) AS 'First Name'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.LastName) AS 'Last Name'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.[Address]) AS Address
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.Phone) AS Phone
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.BirthDate) AS 'Birth Date'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.AgeBand) AS 'Age Band'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.AgeInYears) AS 'Age In Years'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.AgeInMonths) AS 'Age In Months'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.[Service]) AS Service
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.DueFromDate) AS 'Due From Date'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.DueToDate) AS 'Due To Date'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.MinimumCount) AS 'Minimum Count'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.ScheduleDesc) AS 'Schedule Desc'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.PreviousSvcDates) AS 'Previous Service Dates Given'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.AffNum) AS AffNum
   ,CASE 
    WHEN ProviderFullName = '' THEN 'No Provider Name' ELSE ProviderFullName 
   END AS 'PCP Full Name'
   ,(select top 1 MC.ProviderName from EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberClaims MC where MC.ClaimID = PML.ClaimID) AS 'Provider Last Seen'
   ,(select top 1 MC.ProviderAddress from EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberClaims MC where MC.ClaimID = PML.ClaimID) AS 'Provider Last Seen Address'
   ,(select top 1 MC.ProviderPhone from EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberClaims MC where MC.ClaimID = PML.ClaimID) AS 'Provider Last Seen Phone'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), LastServiceDate) AS 'Last Service Date'
   ,CM.SEX 'Gender'
   ,CM.[LANGUAGE] 
   ,CM.HoHFamilylink AS [HOH Family Link]
   ,CM.EmailAddress AS [Subscriber Email]
   ,'Preservice' as [Member_Type]
 FROM EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberList PML(nolock)
 JOIN EPSDTCURRENTMEMBER CM
 ON  PML.MEMBER = LEFT(CM.Member,9)
 AND  PML.PROGNUM = CM.PROGNUM
 AND  PML.MARKET = CM.MARKET
 WHERE PML.ProgNum = @ProgNum
 AND  Year(DUETODATE) = Year(Getdate())

USE [EPSDT]

DECLARE @ProgNum Varchar(1000)

SET @ProgNum =@varProgNum


Delete from EPSDT_OUTREACH Where Member_Type='POSTCARD_OVERDUE'  and ProgNum=@ProgNum;

GO

IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##LASTSEENPROVIDER_OUTREACH') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##LASTSEENPROVIDER_OUTREACH
CREATE TABLE ##LASTSEENPROVIDER_OUTREACH
(
 CLCL_ID    VARCHAR(100)
 ,PRPR_NAME   VARCHAR(100)
 ,PROVIDER_ADDRESS VARCHAR(200)
 ,PROVIDERPHONE  VARCHAR(50)
)

----Use servicing provider's service address location
UPDATE LSP
SET           LSP.PRPR_NAME = PRPR.PRPR_NAME
              ,LSP.PROVIDER_ADDRESS = PRAD_ADDR1+' '+PRAD_ADDR2+' '+PRAD_ADDR3+' '+PRAD_CITY+' '+PRAD_STATE+' '+PRAD_ZIP 
              ,LSP.PROVIDERPHONE = CASE 
            WHEN LEN(PRAD.PRAD_PHONE) > 0 THEN PRAD.PRAD_PHONE + CASE WHEN LEN(PRAD.PRAD_PHONE_EXT) > 0 THEN 'X' + PRAD.PRAD_PHONE_EXT ELSE '' END
            ELSE ''
                                   END
FROM   ##LASTSEENPROVIDER_OUTREACH LSP
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM CLCL(NOLOCK)
ON     LSP.CLCL_ID = CLCL.CLCL_ID
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV PRPR(NOLOCK)
ON     CLCL.PRPR_ID = PRPR.PRPR_ID 
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS PRAD(NOLOCK)
ON     CLCL.PRAD_TYPE = PRAD.PRAD_TYPE  ---- Pulling address from claim
AND    PRAD.PRAD_TERM_DT >= GETDATE()


--  Else use primary address
UPDATE LSP
SET           LSP.PRPR_NAME = PRPR.PRPR_NAME
        ,LSP.PROVIDER_ADDRESS = PRAD.PRAD_ADDR1+' '+PRAD.PRAD_ADDR2+' '+PRAD.PRAD_ADDR3+' '+PRAD.PRAD_CITY+' '+PRAD.PRAD_STATE+' '+PRAD.PRAD_ZIP 
  ,LSP.PROVIDERPHONE = CASE 
        WHEN LEN(PRAD.PRAD_PHONE) > 0 THEN PRAD.PRAD_PHONE + CASE WHEN LEN(PRAD.PRAD_PHONE_EXT) > 0 THEN 'X' + PRAD.PRAD_PHONE_EXT ELSE '' END
        ELSE ''
        END
FROM   ##LASTSEENPROVIDER_OUTREACH LSP                                               
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM CLCL(NOLOCK)
ON     LSP.CLCL_ID = CLCL.CLCL_ID
AND    (LSP.PRPR_NAME IS NULL  OR LSP.PRPR_NAME = '')
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV PRPR(NOLOCK)
ON     CLCL.PRPR_ID = PRPR.PRPR_ID
JOIN   ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS PRAD(NOLOCK)
ON     PRAD.PRAD_ID = PRPR.PRAD_ID
AND    PRPR.PRAD_TYPE_PRIM = PRAD.PRAD_TYPE
AND    PRAD.PRAD_TERM_DT >= GETDATE()

IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##LASTSEENPROVIDER_OUTREACH') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##LASTSEENPROVIDER_OUTREACH
CREATE TABLE ##LASTSEENPROVIDER_OUTREACH
(
 CLCL_ID    VARCHAR(100)
 ,PRPR_NAME   VARCHAR(100)
 ,PROVIDER_ADDRESS VARCHAR(200)
 ,PROVIDERPHONE  VARCHAR(50)
)

USE [EPSDT]

INSERT INTO DBO.EPSDT_OUTREACH
SELECT  DISTINCT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ProgNum) AS ProgNum
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), Market) AS Market
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), left(Member,9)) AS 'Subscriber No'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ALTKEY) AS 'Medicaid No'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), FirstName) AS 'First Name'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), LastName) AS 'Last Name'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), [Address]) AS Address
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), Phone) AS Phone
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), BirthDate) AS 'Birth Date'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AgeBand) AS 'Age Band'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AgeInYears) AS 'Age In Years'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AgeInMonths) AS 'Age In Months'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), [Service]) AS Service
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), DueFromDate) AS 'Due From Date'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), DueToDate) AS 'Due To Date'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), MinimumCount) AS 'Minimum Count'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ScheduleDesc) AS 'Schedule Desc'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PreviousSvcDates) AS 'Previous Service Dates Given'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AffNum) AS AffNum     
   ,PCPFullName    
   ,ISNULL(LSP.PRPR_NAME,'')   'ProviderLastSeen'
   ,ISNULL(LSP.PROVIDER_ADDRESS,'') 'ProviderLastSeenAddress' 
   ,ISNULL(LSP.PROVIDERPHONE,'')  'ProviderLastSeenPhone'  
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), LastServiceDate) AS 'Last Service Date' 
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), GENDER) AS 'GENDER'
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), [Language]) AS 'LANGUAGE' 
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PO.HoHFamilylink) AS [HOH Family Link]
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PO.Email) AS [Subscriber Email] 
   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), 'POSTCARD_OVERDUE') AS [Member_Type] 
--INTO dbo.POSTCARDOVERDUE_OUTREACH
FROM  ##POSTCARDOVERDUE_OUTREACH PO
LEFT JOIN ##LASTSEENPROVIDER_OUTREACH LSP
ON   PO.CLAIMID = LSP.CLCL_ID

GO

DECLARE @EnvironName VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @RootPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @JobId INT
DECLARE @FolderPath VARCHAR(8000)

SET @EnvironName = (SELECT TOP 1 Value FROM EPSDT..EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'Environment')
SET @RootPath = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 Value FROM EPSDT..EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'RootPath' AND EnvironName = @EnvironName),'')
SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDT..EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = 'OutreachExport')
SET @FolderPath = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDT..EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'FolderPath')

SELECT @RootPath + @FolderPath AS RootPathFolder
